Commentary.Commentary: Chahal dropped Sibanda but he came back as he picked up two wickets. Bumrah is the pick of the bowlers as he was sensational with the ball as he took 4 wickets. Zimbabwe lost their plot when they lost 4 wickets in 4 balls and pumped up the Men in Blue. It's a very low target for the flying young Indian lads and hopefully they can chase it down.

Another brilliant bowling display from the young Indian side as the bowled out the opposition to a below-par total. Zimbabwe once again failed to put runs on the board and left nothing for their bowlers. The hosts were cautious in the start and were just rotating strikes.

MS DHONI says it's a good pitch but they were looking for bowl first though. Adds that as the game progresses the pitch will slow down. Confirms that they have made one change as Faiz Fazal comes in for Karun Nair. Ends by saying that he is happy with the bowlers as they have done a brilliant job so far.

GRAEME CREMER says they will bat first as the pitch is hard and no grass on it so it's they would like to bat first. Ends by saying they have made three changes Malcolm Waller, Nevill Madziva and Timycen Maruma come in for Sikandar Raza, Peter Moor and Sean Williams.
TOSS - GRAEME CREMER spins the coin and MS DHONI calls it wrong. ZIMBABWE WILL BAT FIRST!
Pitch report - Pat Symcox says the pitch is hard and with no grass on it. Adds that there are many cracks on the track and it is more suitable for batting first.

Hello and welcome for the coverage of third and final ODI between India and Zimbabwe. The visitors have been sensational with both bat and ball as they outclassed the hosts in the two matches and lead the series 2-0. The home side needs to give its best as to win this match and avoid a whitewash. It's going to be an interesting contest as both the sides will definately look for a win. Stay tuned for the toss...
